name: PACTS (Partnership for Achieving Careers in Technology and Science), The Franklin Institute
what_you_do: Join one of three Saturday morning workshops: Robotics, Science in the City, or Science Investigators. They have career talks, mentoring and field trips. High school Franklin Ambassadors join each workshop to help the students.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 6 to 8 who live in the Philadelphia area.
duration: School year, workshops meet twice a month on Saturday mornings
deadline_text: The page has an Apply link but no dates for the current year.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply to the PACTS Program online form on the page.
notes: For younger teens (grades 6 to 8). Older teens can join the Franklin Ambassador program through STEM Scholars, which has its own card.
